purpose: Validate distributed recurrent-aware rotation training as an independent numerical implementation, without reinterpreting the failed V1 single-versus-dual trajectory gate.

training_host_amendment.original_host_role: canonical checkpoint portability and later inference only
training_host_amendment.reason: User explicitly designated an otherwise idle GPU 6/7 pair on a second server; formal C5/C6 training remains separately gated by the governing V2 protocol.

training_host_revision_2.reason: User chose to return V2 diagnostics and eventual training to the original four-RTX3090 server after the second server's canonical-source dependency blocker was documented.
training_host_revision_2.pair_selection_condition: Both GPUs must remain idle immediately before each diagnostic stage.

checkout_method: Independent git clone --shared from verified origin/main because server Git 1.8.3.1 has no git worktree command; no old working-tree changes copied.

distributed_environment.seed_policy: identical Python, NumPy, torch and CUDA seeds per fresh process

same_topology_reproducibility.fallback_tolerance: must be frozen prospectively before seeing complete five-run results; no posthoc expansion

gradient_correctness.finite_difference: central; multiple epsilon; distinguish STE surrogate from discrete objective

checkpoint_portability.save: rotation plus optimizer metadata and config only

stop_point: report_and_commit_push_only; formal training and AIME require separate approval
